draft_en.subject: The 2.5G models we quoted in August 2024 - still bought in?
draft_en.body:
Hi Johnson,

In August 2024 you asked for our company information and prices for the 8 x 2.5G + 10G SFP+ models, and we quoted $50 non-PoE / $65 PoE. Since then only general product mails from us - no reason to answer those.

The non-PoE unit (1 x 10G SFP+ + 8 x 2.5G, desktop, unmanaged) is $50.1 USD EXW today (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); the PoE version I re-quote on request. Next to the APS08G, a managed 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP in ALFA packing, Marvell-based, is $87.4.

One question: is the 2.5G line still bought in, and is the non-PoE or the PoE version the one that moves?

Best regards,
Simon
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
